rules: Original UI says single-day total damage; WorldBossData uses per-boss historydamage and persistent flag bits. Keep highest daily total and a permanent claimed ledger.
Type 13 resolves through lib_holyfire; these six IDs are exactly the existing gem definitions, not generic unusable props.
Offline 10 daily attempts, damage solver and UTC+8 reset are existing local policy; real server rankings and schedules are not invented.
Old saves retain known todayDamage as minimum peak; cannot reconstruct past daily peak from cumulative damage.
